title: Consolidated progressive delivery and engineering review
summary: One attributable authorization and semantic evolution classifier drive mechanically gated Product/Design/Plan, bounded automatic recovery, progressive engineering review, truthful status/onboarding, and complete cross-host/thread delivery without byte-drift approval loops.

current_state.summary: Taskplane already has signal routing, deep/light dispatch, v3 leases, promotion scaffolding, exact slot conservation, DoR/document classification, immutable partial collection, engine/worktree fingerprints, suite caching, host-parity UX and provider-correct spend. Debt remains over-widening, late blocker publication, metadata contradictions, repeated evaluator failure, global fix cap and sparse lens-value telemetry.

alternatives.name: One authority ledger with semantic evolution classification
alternatives.description: One packet/receipt derives routine stage authority; semantic materiality, not byte drift, controls reauthorization; progressive review remains canonical.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: Hosts standardize an equivalent authority transaction protocol.

alternatives.name: Approval per Product, Design, Plan and recovery
alternatives.description: Each stage owns a separate human checkpoint.

tradeoffs.revisit_when: An opt-in regulated mode legally requires independent phase signers.

alternatives.name: Silent autonomy until final sign-off
alternatives.description: Continue every non-final action without a receipt.

costs: Changed scope/contracts and external actions become unsafe
tradeoffs.revisit_when: Never under the accepted least-privilege requirement.

decision: Compose one consolidated authorization/authority ledger with semantic requirement-contract-authority evolution classification, automatic mechanical gates/recovery, the preserved progressive review ledger, durable truthful status/onboarding, and complete cross-host/thread delivery. Fingerprint drift invalidates stale evidence but is not itself a human gate.

contracts.description: Exactly-once lifecycle ledger for selected and promoted slots plus acceptance evidence.
Immediate immutable provisional request-changes with known evidence and explicit gaps.
One audited equivalence-bounded derivable metadata repair; substance retries affected slot.
Mandatory floors, evidence-deep lenses, <=1 sweep and deterministic promotion/rejection.
Exact-key expiring verified infrastructure-unavailable cache without lens verdict.
Measured finding/evidence progress and bounded continue/escalate decisions.
Post-review versioned quality/uniqueness/latency/cost telemetry isolated from current review.
One attributable packet and stage derivations cover unchanged routine work; only semantic material authority changes reauthorize.
Bounded classified routine repair/retry/convergence with explicit safety/authority/exhaustion escalation.
Classified self-repair and exact dynamic sibling-worktree engine resolution.
Conditional seven-field internal Product advice that never gates.
JSON authority, inline small output, automatic complete Markdown, optional HTML.
Actor/thread/target/revision-bound approval and complete accessible fallback delivery.

acceptance_map.criterion: One authorization covers routine end-to-end work.** A consolidated packet identifies the requirement, conditional design/plan, target and scope, acceptance criteria, dynamic-validation intent, ordinary sandbox authority, routine fix/recovery policy, evaluation/collection, artifact delivery, and execution bounds. One attributable approval authorizes those unchanged activities through final-signoff readiness. **Verify:** all ten flow fixtures complete routine stages without another approval and retain one receipt plus stage-by-stage authority derivation.

Run: python3 -m pytest -q taskplane/tests/test_consolidated_flow.py -k ac_01.

acceptance_map.criterion: Mechanical definition gates auto-advance.** Product, Design, and Plan stages automatically complete/score/check and advance when their contracts, graph checks, acceptance mapping, required design/review lenses, and evidence pass. They do not request separate Product, Design, or Plan approval. **Verify:** pass/fail fixtures assert automatic advance only on complete evidence and a named non-human blocker when mechanical checks fail.

acceptance_map.criterion: Human-attention boundaries are closed and explicit.** A new human decision occurs only for initial consolidated authorization; explicit A/B selection; exhausted/no-progress recovery or replan; material scope creep or major authority change; destructive/irreversible action; new external system, credential, publication, or spend; changed acceptance criteria; recovery that weakens a gate; or final sign-off. **Verify:** an approval trace for every flow contains no other prompt and each allowed prompt names the new fact, consequence, and authority requested.

acceptance_map.criterion: Silence never expands authority.** Missing, stale, ambiguous, or unauthenticated responses pause only the affected human-owned decision and cannot authorize additional scope, external effects, destructive action, changed criteria, weakened controls, or final approval. **Verify:** timeout, replay, wrong-thread, wrong-revision, and free-form ambiguous fixtures.

acceptance_map.criterion: Routine recovery is automatic and bounded.** Within authorized scope, Taskplane retries or mechanically repairs transient, metadata, evaluator, collection, artifact, render, and setup failures automatically two to three times or while measurable convergence continues. It asks only after the bounded policy is exhausted, progress stops/oscillates/worsens, safety or authority changes, or replan is needed. **Verify:** one-, two-, three-, converging-longer, no-progress, repeated-fingerprint, unsafe, and authority- change cases assert recover/escalate behavior and reasons.

risks.mitigation: Catalog floors are unconditional; promotions require attributable evidence; ambiguity widens minimally with explanation.

risks.risk: Early provisional output is mistaken for exhaustive approval-ready review.
risks.mitigation: Schema/gate require request-changes, explicit gap manifest and approval disabled.

risks.risk: Repair/cache forges substantive review or crosses worktrees.
risks.mitigation: Equivalence allowlist plus exact repository/root/engine/run/lease binding and expiry.

risks.risk: Convergence loops indefinitely or broadens scope.
risks.mitigation: Task bound, two no-progress threshold, oscillation/fingerprint/safety/scope/human escalation; no auto-approval.

risks.risk: Telemetry biases current producers or leaks data.
risks.mitigation: Derive only after sealed revisions/adjudication; no current-routing read edge; redact to bounded fingerprints/counts.

risks.risk: Byte-level design evolution repeatedly invalidates human approval.
risks.mitigation: Classify normalized requirement/contract/target/scope/authority semantics; byte drift only invalidates stale mechanical evidence.
Closed authority ledger; missing/stale/ambiguous receipts pause only affected boundary; destructive/external/material changes reauthorize.

risks.risk: Automatic recovery loops or weakens gates.
risks.mitigation: Typed classes, 2–3 retries/convergence rules, immutable evidence and explicit exhausted/safety/authority escalation.

risks.risk: Thread/status/UI becomes parallel truth or loses large evidence.
risks.mitigation: Canonical JSON/revisions remain authority; snapshot-only status; complete Markdown and attributed receipts.

failure_modes.mode: Mandatory floor or promoted slot disappears.
failure_modes.detection: review_slot_ledger reports selected/promoted versus lifecycle conservation.
failure_modes.recovery: ReviewKernel aborts approval immediately and retries only named missing slot within Plan bound.
Routing owner records canonical rejection; admissible concern is promoted once, never substituted.

failure_modes.detection: review_metadata_repair reports before/after equivalence and allowlist result.
failure_modes.recovery: Recovery owner rejects repair and reruns affected slot only, maximum Plan retry bound.

failure_modes.mode: Infrastructure cache key is stale or mismatched.
failure_modes.detection: evaluator_health_cache reports full key, TTL and invalidation reason.
failure_modes.recovery: Evaluator owner invalidates and probes once; verified unavailable never becomes verdict.

failure_modes.mode: Fix cycles show no progress, oscillation, regression or unsafe scope change.
failure_modes.detection: review_convergence reports finding sets/evidence delta and decision reason.
failure_modes.recovery: Loop owner escalates after two no-progress cycles or immediately on unsafe/scope/human stop.

failure_modes.detection: lens_quality_metric reports definition version and availability.
failure_modes.recovery: Telemetry owner records unavailable, never zero, and does not affect review.

failure_modes.mode: Authority packet or derivation is stale, ambiguous or wrong-thread.
failure_modes.recovery: Authority owner pauses only affected boundary and requests the exact new fact/authority once.

failure_modes.mode: Design/plan bytes change without semantic materiality.
failure_modes.detection: semantic_evolution reports byte-only/non-material/material/unsafe with requirement-contract-authority delta.
failure_modes.recovery: Orchestrator mechanically revalidates byte/non-material changes and continues; material/unsafe reauthorizes or pauses.

failure_modes.mode: Routine repair/retry is exhausted or stops converging.
failure_modes.detection: automatic_recovery reports class, attempts, fingerprints and convergence.
failure_modes.recovery: Recovery owner escalates after 2–3 attempts or convergence stop, never weakens a gate.

failure_modes.mode: Large/thread delivery or native control fails.
failure_modes.detection: artifact_delivery and thread_continuation report semantic counts, retry and control availability.
failure_modes.recovery: Delivery owner retries automatically then supplies complete Markdown/artifacts and attributable reply actions.

signals: review_slot_ledger: each selected slot lifecycle and acceptance evidence
semantic_evolution: byte/non-material/material/unsafe deltas and authority result
alerts: Block approval on any ledger conservation or acceptance-evidence gap.
Block repair on substantive change or failed equivalence.
Invalidate health cache on any key/TTL/repair change.
Escalate after two no-progress cycles, repeated fingerprint, oscillation, regression, unsafe or scope change.

rollout.strategy: Behind TASKPLANE_CONSOLIDATED_FLOW, dual-record packet/evolution; enable mechanical Product/Design/Plan auto-advance; preparation/recovery; preserved progressive review; status/onboarding; Markdown/thread delivery. Compare Codex/Claude/Slack/worktree/legacy goldens each phase.
rollout.rollback: Disable new consolidated packets, finish in-flight work with retained readers, route to legacy bounded/Markdown delivery, and preserve immutable evidence. Rollback cannot auto-approve, delete evidence, or reverse authority decisions.
